modules.trigger: The source contains multiple subjects or an explicit foreground/background composition.
modules.instruction: Name the primary visual center, preserve every requested component and role, and keep the background uncluttered. Add no decorative objects, crowds, or secondary actions.
expected_side_effects: Monitor entity omission and scene coverage.

modules.trigger: The source names multiple instances or requires a subject to persist across an action.
modules.instruction: Preserve the requested count and bind each action to the same instance. Give persistent subjects only the minimum stable visual identifiers needed for continuity.
expected_side_effects: Monitor prompt length and visual clutter.

modules.trigger: The source states a spatial relation that changes over time.
modules.instruction: State subject, reference, initial relation, transition, and final relation in that order. Keep both entities visible and add no detours or competing trajectories.
expected_side_effects: Monitor motion rationality and instance continuity.

modules.trigger: The source contains two or more ordered events or an explicit cause and result.
modules.instruction: Express a concise beginning, transition, and observable result. Keep every action bound to its original subject and preserve the stated order.
expected_side_effects: Monitor action completion, identity, and physical plausibility.

modules.trigger: A visible person performs an action whose pose or motion must remain physically plausible.
modules.instruction: Use the minimum sufficient pose and motion description. Keep limbs visible and attached, and describe ground or object contact when it explains propulsion. Add no unrequested acrobatics, cuts, or simultaneous gestures.
expected_side_effects: Monitor action completion as well as anatomy.

modules.trigger: The source specifies force, collision, mechanical motion, deformation, or breakage.
modules.instruction: Make only the source-implied cause, direction, process, and material response explicit. Preserve object identity and do not import a contradictory terminal state.
expected_side_effects: Monitor whether added process detail obscures the main action.

modules.trigger: The source explicitly specifies a camera move, orbit, or static shot.
modules.instruction: Preserve the requested shot, viewpoint, direction, and speed. If the source is static, keep the camera static; never add a secondary move or cut.
expected_side_effects: Monitor false camera motion and subject continuity.
